reason: In apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx, onSuccess (patch L89-94) resets the emails but not isInvalidEmail, and onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog} (L114) clears neither the emails nor the error; since the dialog stays mounted in BookingListItem, both come back when it is reopened. Also, handleAdd returns silently when the list is empty (L102-104), and the uniqueness check uses a plain `new Set(emails)` (L79-82), so it is case-sensitive.
